decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider from Coinbase Commerce to Transak does not alter secondary-sale royalty enforcement, pool destinations, or ticket-generation rules.
The Transak provider choice does not change the Brevo email provider or transactional email delivery behavior.
The source selects a fiat on-ramp provider but does not change SIWE authentication for crypto minting or NFT-transfer paths.
The provider selection does not modify the established email magic-link authentication behavior or its dashboard-access purpose.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not affect unauthenticated access to public APIs, leaderboards, or pool values.
The Transak decision does not change the approved badge set or badge icon rules.
Selecting Transak for the fiat on-ramp does not change the requirement concerning deployment of the smart-contract system on Base.
The source does not change the referral commission amount, recipient, trigger, or automatic payout mode.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not alter the NFT metadata counters or permanent badge visibility.
Selecting Transak does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or reward components.
The provider change does not modify prize-ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, reset behavior, or secondary-sale ticket rules.
The Transak selection does not affect random winner selection, ticket weighting, or draw eligibility.
